svg.title: Yagi reached 125 kt, the strongest storm of 2024
svg.desc: Twenty-nine tropical cyclone lifelines from May to December 2024. Each peak circle is sized and shaded by maximum wind speed.
svg.text: YAGI reached 125 kt — the strongest storm of 2024
Each column = one cyclone life · ○ start/end · ● peak · circle size and shade = peak wind (kt) · orange = annual maximum
Twenty-nine HKO tracks · 652 six-hourly observations · May–December 2024
